access_token.description: A token to be added as a query parameter to every subsequent API request. This token will authorize and authenticate your API requests.

expire_on.description: A date-time indicating when the token will expire.

scope.description: The scope of this token, 'brand' by default.

token_type.description: A type for this token. This is currently always set to 'Bearer'.

client_id.description: The client id of an API key created in your Le New Black account, under Settings › API. The key must open the Wholesale API v2.

client_secret.description: The client secret shown once when the key was created.

grant_type.description: The authentication type being used. Must always be 'client_credentials'.

scope.description: Optional. 'brand' (the default) for the Wholesale API v2.

SetPaymentTermRequest.title: SetPaymentTermRequest
SetPaymentTermRequest.description: Request body to create or update a payment term

action.description: ADD to assign the sales rep to the retailer, REMOVE to unassign

drop_start_on.description: Drop period start date. Omit the property to leave the stored date untouched, send an empty string to clear it. Must be present on every item of the batch or on none of them.

drop_end_on.description: Drop period end date. Omit the property to leave the stored date untouched, send an empty string to clear it. Must be present on every item of the batch or on none of them.

price_list_code.description: Code of the price list, as returned by /price_lists. The prices of a variant are those of the default price period only: read /prices for the prices of each period.

AuthRateLimitExceeded.description: Too many credential exchanges for this client id in one minute. This limit applies before the client secret is checked and is separate from the per-token limit below.

InvalidQueryParameter.description: A query or path parameter is present but its value cannot be honoured: a malformed date, a non-numeric page, a status outside the documented list, an LNB-generated reference (PO-…, PMNT-…) with a character outside letters, digits, "-" and "_", or several values for one parameter. Identifiers written by the brand (models, codes, retailer references, document numbers) accept any string and are matched exactly. The parameter and the accepted format are named in message_user_friendly. The filter is never dropped silently, so the unfiltered listing is never returned in its place.

message_user_friendly.example: Invalid value for query parameter "order_time_from" (expected a date formatted YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS)

RateLimitExceeded.description: API call rate limit has been exceeded (60 requests per minute per token)

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in current window (0 when exceeded)

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp when the window resets

X-RateLimit-Reset-Time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the window resets

message.example: API call rate limit has been exceeded.

x-rate-limiting.description: All API endpoints are subject to rate limiting on a per-token basis. The rate limit is enforced using a 60-second sliding window. Every API response includes rate limit headers, even when the limit is not exceeded.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per minute

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Number of requests remaining in the current window

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp when the current window resets

X-RateLimit-Reset-Time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the current window resets

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (only relevant on 429)

X-RateLimit-Request-Count.description: Current request count in the active window

error.message: API call rate limit has been exceeded.
